maddeler.e:
نتلبرل (form IIq)
# نَتَلَبْرَلُ (natalabralu) /na.ta.lab.ra.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# نَتَلَبْرَلَ (natalabrala) /na.ta.lab.ra.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# نَتَلَبْرَلْ (natalabral) /na.ta.lab.ral/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
